items.name: The Godfather
items.description: The Godfather is a 1972 crime drama directed by Francis Ford Coppola. It follows the Corleone family, a powerful Mafia clan in New York City. The story explores themes of power, loyalty, and family legacy. Marlon Brando stars as Vito Corleone, the aging patriarch. The film is widely regarded as one of the greatest movies ever made.

items.name: Star Wars
items.description: Star Wars is a 1977 space opera created by George Lucas. It introduces a galaxy far, far away with Jedi knights and the Force. The plot follows Luke Skywalker as he discovers his destiny. The film revolutionized special effects and merchandising. It spawned a massive franchise that continues today.

items.name: The Shawshank Redemption
items.description: The Shawshank Redemption is a 1994 drama based on a Stephen King novella. It tells the story of Andy Dufresne, a banker wrongly convicted of murder. The film explores themes of hope, friendship, and redemption. Tim Robbins and Morgan Freeman star in this prison drama. It's often cited as one of the best films of all time.

items.name: Pulp Fiction
items.description: Pulp Fiction is a 1994 nonlinear crime film written and directed by Quentin Tarantino. It weaves together multiple stories involving hitmen, boxers, and diner robbers. The movie is known for its sharp dialogue and pop culture references. John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, and Uma Thurman star. It redefined modern filmmaking techniques.

items.name: Inception
items.description: Inception is a 2010 science fiction action film directed by Christopher Nolan. It follows thieves who enter people's dreams to steal secrets. The complex plot involves layered dream worlds. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as the lead extractor. The film explores themes of reality and subconsciousness.

items.name: The Matrix
items.description: The Matrix is a 1999 science fiction action film directed by the Wachowskis. It depicts a dystopian future where humans are trapped in a simulated reality. Neo discovers the truth and joins a rebellion. Keanu Reeves stars as the chosen one. The film popularized bullet time effects.

items.name: Titanic
items.description: Titanic is a 1997 romantic disaster film directed by James Cameron. It tells the story of the ill-fated RMS Titanic voyage. Leonardo DiCaprio and Kate Winslet star as star-crossed lovers. The film recreates the ship's sinking with groundbreaking CGI. It became the highest-grossing film of its time.

items.name: Avatar
items.description: Avatar is a 2009 epic science fiction film directed by James Cameron. It follows a paraplegic marine on the alien planet Pandora. The story explores themes of environmentalism and imperialism. The film features groundbreaking 3D technology. It holds the record for highest-grossing film for many years.

items.name: Jurassic Park
items.description: Jurassic Park is a 1993 science fiction adventure film directed by Steven Spielberg. It involves a theme park with cloned dinosaurs. The story explores the dangers of playing God with genetics. Sam Neill, Laura Dern, and Jeff Goldblum star. The film revolutionized CGI in cinema.

items.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
items.description: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring is a 2001 fantasy epic directed by Peter Jackson. It begins J.R.R. Tolkien's epic tale of Middle-earth. Frodo Baggins must destroy a powerful ring. The film features stunning visual effects and world-building. It launched a trilogy that defined modern fantasy filmmaking.

items.name: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
items.description: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone is a 2001 fantasy film directed by Chris Columbus. It introduces the wizarding world and young Harry Potter. Daniel Radcliffe stars as the boy who lived. The film is based on J.K. Rowling's bestselling book. It began a franchise that spans eight films.

items.name: The Avengers
items.description: The Avengers is a 2012 superhero film directed by Joss Whedon. It brings together Marvel's heroes to fight a common threat. Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, and others team up. The film is part of the Marvel Cinematic Universe. It grossed over $1.5 billion worldwide.

items.name: Frozen
items.description: Frozen is a 2013 animated musical fantasy film produced by Disney. It tells the story of two royal sisters in Arendelle. Elsa has ice powers that she struggles to control. The film features songs like 'Let It Go'. It became one of Disney's highest-grossing animated films.

items.name: Toy Story
items.description: Toy Story is a 1995 animated film directed by John Lasseter. It was Pixar's first feature film. The story follows toys that come to life when humans aren't around. Woody and Buzz Lightyear are central characters. The film revolutionized computer animation.

items.name: Finding Nemo
items.description: Finding Nemo is a 2003 animated adventure film produced by Pixar. It follows a clownfish searching for his son Nemo. Marlin and Dory embark on an ocean journey. The film explores themes of parental love and perseverance. It won an Academy Award for Best Animated Feature.

items.name: The Lion King
items.description: The Lion King is a 1994 animated musical film produced by Disney. It tells the story of Simba, a young lion cub. The film explores the circle of life and responsibility. It features memorable songs like 'Hakuna Matata'. The story is inspired by Hamlet and African culture.

items.name: Beauty and the Beast
items.description: Beauty and the Beast is a 1991 animated musical film produced by Disney. It tells the story of Belle and an enchanted prince. The film explores themes of inner beauty and love. It was the first animated film nominated for Best Picture. The story is based on a classic fairy tale.

items.name: Aladdin
items.description: Aladdin is a 1992 animated musical film produced by Disney. It follows a street rat who finds a magic lamp. Robin Williams voices the Genie in a memorable performance. The film is set in the fictional city of Agrabah. It features songs like 'A Whole New World'.

items.name: Moana
items.description: Moana is a 2016 animated musical film produced by Disney. It follows a Polynesian girl on a voyage to save her island. The film celebrates Polynesian culture and mythology. It features original songs and stunning animation. Dwayne Johnson voices the demigod Maui.

items.name: Coco
items.description: Coco is a 2017 animated musical film produced by Pixar. It follows a boy who dreams of becoming a musician. Miguel embarks on a journey to the Land of the Dead. The film explores family, music, and Mexican culture. It won two Academy Awards including Best Animated Feature.

items.name: The Dark Knight
items.description: The Dark Knight is a 2008 superhero film directed by Christopher Nolan. It features Batman facing off against the Joker. Heath Ledger's performance as the Joker is iconic. The film explores themes of chaos and heroism. It is considered one of the best superhero films ever made.

items.name: Forrest Gump
items.description: Forrest Gump is a 1994 comedy-drama starring Tom Hanks. It follows a man with a low IQ who experiences major historical events. The film won six Academy Awards including Best Picture. It explores themes of destiny and perseverance. Jenny and Bubba are key supporting characters.

items.name: The Silence of the Lambs
items.description: The Silence of the Lambs is a 1991 psychological thriller directed by Jonathan Demme. Jodie Foster stars as an FBI trainee seeking a serial killer. Anthony Hopkins plays the cannibalistic psychiatrist Hannibal Lecter. The film won five Academy Awards. It is based on Thomas Harris's novel.

items.name: Schindler's List
items.description: Schindler's List is a 1993 historical drama directed by Steven Spielberg. It tells the story of Oskar Schindler during the Holocaust. Liam Neeson stars as Schindler. The film is shot in black and white. It won seven Academy Awards including Best Picture.

items.name: Gladiator
items.description: Gladiator is a 2000 historical epic directed by Ridley Scott. Russell Crowe stars as Maximus, a betrayed Roman general. The film features spectacular battle scenes. It won five Academy Awards including Best Picture. Joaquin Phoenix plays the villainous Commodus.

items.name: Braveheart
items.description: Braveheart is a 1995 historical epic directed by Mel Gibson. It tells the story of William Wallace and Scottish independence. Mel Gibson stars and directs the film. The film won five Academy Awards. It features intense battle sequences.

items.name: Saving Private Ryan
items.description: Saving Private Ryan is a 1998 war film directed by Steven Spielberg. It depicts World War II from the American perspective. Tom Hanks leads the cast. The opening D-Day sequence is particularly intense. The film won five Academy Awards.

items.name: The Green Mile
items.description: The Green Mile is a 1999 fantasy drama based on Stephen King's novel. It follows prison guards and a death row inmate. Tom Hanks and Michael Clarke Duncan star. The film explores themes of justice and miracles. It is set in the 1930s.

items.name: Fight Club
items.description: Fight Club is a 1999 film directed by David Fincher. It follows an insomniac who starts an underground fight club. Brad Pitt and Edward Norton star. The film satirizes consumer culture. It has become a cult classic.
